messages.subject: Pi-Orca launch path verified
messages.body: I read the version-matched Orca CLI/orchestration guides plus public help/state for repo 82d45ea7-e3a7-4510-adf0-aa98dbca44eb and verified it is /tmp/pi-orca-smoke-WExO6Nvw with no setup script and start-immediately setup policy. Smallest supported path is custom Orca terminals, not launcher-default mutation: lead with `orca-ide terminal create --worktree id:82d45ea7-e3a7-4510-adf0-aa98dbca44eb::/tmp/pi-orca-smoke-WExO6Nvw --title 'Pi bridge lead' --command 'pi --no-extensions -e /home/alex/Work/pi-orca/bridge/src/index.ts' --json`, and supervised workers by creating/waiting the same custom Pi terminal in the target worktree then `orca-ide orchestration worker-start --task <task_id> --terminal <handle> --timeout-ms 60000 --json`; for new worker worktrees first use `orca-ide worktree create --repo id:82d45ea7-e3a7-4510-adf0-aa98dbca44eb --name <name> --no-parent --setup run --json`, then create the Pi terminal in the returned full worktree id. No documented scoped Pi default-argument setting was exposed, `worker-start --model` is documented for Claude/Codex/Cursor only, `dispatch --inject` is unsupervised, `worker-start --terminal` keeps lifecycle/worker-read/worker-show supervision while release safely retains pre-existing or reused terminals, and durable answered-question confirmation after reload is `orca-ide orchestration ask --resume <message_id> --timeout-ms <n> --json` rather than volatile memory.
